bull.t: Exceptional demand visibility and revenue growth
bull.b: Rapid revenue growth and a substantially expanded contracted backlog indicate strong customer demand for AI infrastructure and provide multi-year visibility. This supports continued capacity utilization, enables disciplined expansion, and reduces reliance on purely short-term or spot-market GPU demand.

The high adjusted EBITDA margin and year-over-year doubling of EBITDA show that CoreWeave can generate substantial operating earnings as its infrastructure base scales. These economics could support reinvestment and improve financial resilience if utilization and customer commitments remain strong.

bull.t: Expansion into higher-value AI platform services
bull.b: Packaging tested environments for robotics, autonomous vehicles, and simulation expands CoreWeave beyond raw GPU access into workflow software and engineering enablement. This can deepen customer integration, reduce setup friction, and increase the value captured from its infrastructure and platform stack over time.

bear.t: Very high leverage limits financial flexibility
bear.b: Debt that greatly exceeds equity leaves CoreWeave financially dependent on continued access to capital and successful capacity deployment. High leverage increases refinancing and interest-rate exposure, limits room to absorb weaker utilization, and can constrain future investment or strategic flexibility.

bear.t: Growth requires exceptionally heavy capital investment
bear.b: Although operating cash flow is strong, the business currently spends far more on infrastructure than it generates after investment. Sustaining expansion therefore requires substantial financing and flawless execution, while any delay in customer ramp or capacity utilization could prolong cash burn.

bear.t: Net losses and rising interest expense hinder earnings conversion
bear.b: CoreWeave’s attractive gross and adjusted operating economics have not yet translated into GAAP profitability. Rising interest expense absorbs a growing share of operating gains, making earnings conversion dependent on rapid scale, margin improvement, and sustained customer uptake across the expanding asset base.
